nodes.name: error-as-empty.md
nodes.summary: Design note capturing the finding that error states rendered as empty states were the dominant trust defect for novice users, driving a UX fix mandate to surface real error messages.

nodes.name: judge-round1-patterns.md
nodes.summary: Post-mortem note from the first agent judge round identifying that self-contradiction in agent outputs kills user trust faster than any missing feature, with observed patterns from round 1 evaluation.

nodes.name: memory-import-is-the-aha.md
nodes.summary: Design insight note identifying the memory-import step as the critical first-session "it knows me" moment for user retention, with a directive to protect and prioritize this flow.

nodes.name: provenance-not-raw-logs.md
nodes.summary: UX framing note directing that agent self-evolution should be communicated to users via provenance badges and tangible benefits rather than exposing raw internal logs.

nodes.name: risk-vocabulary-drift.md
nodes.summary: Engineering note warning that drifted risk/severity enum values silently inverted safety UX, mandating a single shared risk vocabulary across the codebase.

nodes.name: silent-defaults-over-ratification.md
nodes.summary: Product principle note advocating for shipping silent sensible defaults and reserving user friction only for irreversible actions, reducing unnecessary confirmation dialogs.

nodes.name: staged-evidence-catch22.md
nodes.summary: Evaluation insight note explaining that growth evidence cannot be staged because judges detect and penalize artificial staging, requiring authentic incremental evidence for the evolution system.
